title: pilosella piloselloides subsp. albidobractea
intro: Pilosella piloselloides subsp. albidobractea, commonly known as Alpine Mouse-ear or White-bracted Mouse-ear, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella piloselloides subsp. albidobractea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic potential of this plant.
